title: St. Urban Tower
visualBrief: Specific restored St Urban Tower in Kosice: pale-plaster square body/floor bands, small closed windows, genuinely open round-arched upper belfry, simple original roundel frieze, steep flared pyramidal brown tiled roof/vent/gilt ball/iron finial, low open round-arched arcade with two rounded western corners/red-brown roofs and selected central portal relief. Existing shared low-frequency stucco/stone/roof/paint graphs; no copied epitaphs, heraldry, inscriptions, photographs, museum interior, temporary restoration fence, neighboring cathedral or whole square platform.
